name: Omaclippy
author: Dorneles
description: The nostalgic Microsoft Clippy companion for the Omarchy desktop. Features authentic retro sprite animations, sound effects, speech balloons with tips, interactive drag & drop, and reactive desktop behaviors.

barWidget.description: Clippy desktop companion — click to open control panel and trigger animations

schema.label: Clippy Active
schema.description: Whether Clippy is currently active on your screen.

schema.label: Companion Mode
schema.description: Behavior mode: Stationary companion, wandering screen, or perching on windows.

schema.label: Clippy Size
schema.description: Visual size of Clippy on screen.

schema.label: Sound Effects
schema.description: Play authentic sound effects with animations.

schema.label: Speech Bubbles
schema.description: Show retro speech balloons with tips and messages.

schema.label: React to Cursor
schema.description: Clippy glances in the direction of the mouse pointer via Hyprland sockets.

schema.label: React to Windows
schema.description: Clippy reacts to moving windows via Hyprland sockets.

schema.label: Hardware Pointer Monitoring
schema.description: Optional low-level hardware pointer click monitoring (/dev/input). Disabled by default. Only pointer/touch devices are inspected when enabled; keyboards are never opened.
